entries.text: Configure load balancer access logs inside the one existing load balancer resource, never declare the same Terraform resource name twice.
ECS tasks in private subnets need outbound access: add a NAT gateway or VPC endpoints for ECR, CloudWatch Logs and Secrets Manager, otherwise tasks cannot start.
When users reach the service from the internet, the load balancer must be internet-facing in public subnets; keep only tasks and databases in private subnets.

run.input_text: Deploy a containerized Python REST API on AWS ECS Fargate in eu-central-1. Traffic comes from the internet over HTTPS through an Application Load Balancer with an existing ACM certificate (pass the ARN as a variable). The containers run in private subnets across two availability zones and pull the image from Amazon ECR. The API uses a PostgreSQL database on Amazon RDS in private subnets, with automated backups and encryption at rest. Store the database password in AWS Secrets Manager. Enable autoscaling between 2 and 6 tasks based on CPU usage. Send container logs to CloudWatch Logs. Expected load is about 200 requests per second at peak. Keep the monthly cost reasonable for a small company.

+
+resource "aws_cloudwatch_log_group" "infraarch_vpc_flow" {
+  name_prefix = "/infraarch/vpc-flow-"
+  retention_in_days = 365
+  kms_key_id = "${aws_kms_key.infraarch_security.arn}"
+}
+
+resource "aws_flow_log" "infraarch_main" {
+  vpc_id = "${aws_vpc.main.id}"
+  traffic_type = "ALL"
+  log_destination_type = "cloud-watch-logs"
+  log_destination = "${aws_cloudwatch_log_group.infraarch_vpc_flow.arn}"
+  iam_role_arn = "${aws_iam_role.infraarch_vpc_flow.arn}"
+  depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy.infraarch_vpc_flow]
+}
+
+resource "aws_iam_role" "infraarch_vpc_flow" {
+  name_prefix = "infraarch-flow-"
+  assume_role_policy = "{\"Version\": \"2012-10-17\", \"Statement\": [{\"Effect\": \"Allow\", \"Principal\": {\"Service\": \"vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com\"}, \"Action\": \"sts:AssumeRole\", \"Condition\": {\"StringEquals\": {\"aws:SourceAccount\": \"${data.aws_caller_identity.infraarch_security.account_id}\"}}}]}"
+}
+
+resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "infraarch_vpc_flow" {
+  name_prefix = "infraarch-flow-"
+  role = "${aws_iam_role.infraarch_vpc_flow.id}"
+  policy = "{\"Version\": \"2012-10-17\", \"Statement\": [{\"Effect\": \"Allow\", \"Action\": [\"logs:CreateLogStream\", \"logs:PutLogEvents\", \"logs:DescribeLogStreams\"], \"Resource\": \"${aws_cloudwatch_log_group.infraarch_vpc_flow.arn}:*\"}, {\"Effect\": \"Allow\", \"Action\": [\"logs:DescribeLogGroups\"], \"Resource\": \"*\"}]}"
+}
+
+resource "aws_kms_alias" "infraarch_security" {
+  name_prefix = "alias/infraarch-security-"
+  target_key_id = "${aws_kms_key.infraarch_security.key_id}"
+}
+
+resource "aws_kms_key" "infraarch_security" {
+  description = "Infrastructure security encryption"
+  enable_key_rotation = true
+  deletion_window_in_days = 30
+  policy = "{\"Version\": \"2012-10-17\", \"Statement\": [{\"Sid\": \"AccountAdministration\", \"Effect\": \"Allow\", \"Principal\": {\"AWS\": \"arn:${data.aws_partition.infraarch_security.partition}:iam::${data.aws_caller_identity.infraarch_security.account_id}:root\"}, \"Action\": \"kms:*\", \"Resource\": \"*\"}, {\"Sid\": \"ScopedLogEncryption\", \"Effect\": \"Allow\", \"Principal\": {\"Service\": \"logs.${data.aws_region.infraarch_security.name}.${data.aws_partition.infraarch_security.dns_suffix}\"}, \"Action\": [\"kms:Encrypt\", \"kms:Decrypt\", \"kms:ReEncrypt*\", \"kms:GenerateDataKey*\", \"kms:DescribeKey\"], \"Resource\": \"*\", \"Condition\": {\"ArnLike\": {\"kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn\": \"arn:${data.aws_partition.infraarch_security.partition}:logs:${data.aws_region.infraarch_security.name}:${data.aws_caller_identity.infraarch_security.account_id}:log-group:/infraarch/vpc-flow-*\"}}}]}"
+}
+

+}
